name: Azur Lodge
insider_take: This boutique lakefront gem puts you right on the shores of Lake Wakatipu with the dramatic Remarkables mountain range as your backdrop - pure Queenstown magic.
whats_special: Azur Lodge sits directly on Lake Wakatipu's pristine shoreline, offering unobstructed views of the lake and surrounding peaks. The property features just 10 luxury suites, ensuring intimate service and exclusivity. Built with local schist stone and cedar, it seamlessly blends into Queenstown's natural landscape while maintaining sophisticated elegance.
pro_tip: Book a lakeview suite on the upper level - you'll have front-row seats to Queenstown's famous sunsets over the Remarkables, and you can watch the vintage steamship TSS Earnslaw cruise by your window.
dont_miss: Take advantage of the lodge's private beach access for morning lake swims, and explore the nearby Queenstown Gardens - a 5-minute walk along the lake. The lodge is also perfectly positioned for the Skyline Gondola, just minutes away, offering 360-degree views of the Southern Alps.
pros: Stunning lakefront location with panoramic views of Lake Wakatipu
Intimate boutique property with personalized service
Prime Queenstown location near adventure activities and dining
Luxury accommodations with premium amenities and local design elements
cons: Limited room inventory due to boutique size
